turns.content: I need help crafting a LinkedIn post for the Fujifilm X100VI. Here are the facts: it has a 23mm f/2 lens, a 26.1MP sensor, and a classic design. Can you create a post that highlights these features?

I created the draft and validated it against the confirmed product facts and requested constraints.

Introducing the Fujifilm X100VI! This camera features a 23mm f/2 lens, a 26.1MP sensor, and a classic design. Perfect for photography enthusiasts seeking quality and style. Discover more today!
